library_question: Does the standard utility-interruption allocation apply without limiting a non-waivable landlord duty?

blocks.text: Landlord is not an insurer against interruptions caused by a utility provider, storm, outage, government action, Tenant nonpayment, or circumstances outside Landlord's reasonable control. Tenant must promptly report any condition affecting health, safety, or property. This section does not excuse a duty imposed by K.S.A. 58-2553 or liability for an interruption caused or prolonged by Landlord's breach, negligence, or willful conduct.
